name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
description: Connect your own Microsoft Defender for Endpoint tenant (Azure AD App Registration) to manage Machines, Alerts, Incidents, custom Indicators, Machine Actions (isolate/scan), Advanced Hunting queries, and Threat & Vulnerability Management.

tools.name: connect_defender
tools.description: Connect your own Microsoft Defender for Endpoint tenant by saving its Azure AD tenant/client credentials, after checking they actually work.

label.description: Friendly tenant label, e.g. 'Acme Corp Tenant'.
label.title: Label

tenant_id.description: Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) the App Registration belongs to.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

client_id.description: Azure AD Application (client) ID with WindowsDefenderATP API permissions.
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: Azure AD Application client secret value.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

tools.name: disconnect_defender
tools.description: Disconnect a Microsoft Defender for Endpoint tenant: deletes the saved Azure AD credentials. Nothing in Defender itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Microsoft Defender for Endpoint tenants (tenant id + masked Client ID).

tools.name: list_machines
tools.description: List endpoints (machines) in the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant, optionally filtered by an OData $filter.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_machine
tools.description: Read one endpoint (machine) in full by its Defender machine id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: isolate_machine
tools.description: Network-isolate a machine -- cuts it off from the network except Defender cloud traffic (and optionally Outlook/Skype/Teams for 'Selective'). The core incident-response 'stop the bleeding' action.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

machine_id.description: Defender machine id to act on.
machine_id.title: Machine Id

comment.description: Reason/comment for this action, required by the Defender API and shown in the action audit trail.
comment.title: Comment

tools.name: unisolate_machine
tools.description: Release a machine from network isolation, restoring normal network access.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

machine_id.description: Defender machine id to act on.
machine_id.title: Machine Id

comment.description: Reason/comment for this action, required by the Defender API and shown in the action audit trail.
comment.title: Comment

tools.name: run_av_scan
tools.description: Trigger a Windows Defender antivirus scan (Quick or Full) on a machine.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

machine_id.description: Defender machine id to act on.
machine_id.title: Machine Id

comment.description: Reason/comment for this action, required by the Defender API and shown in the action audit trail.
comment.title: Comment

tools.name: stop_and_quarantine_file
tools.description: Stop a running process and quarantine its file on a machine, by SHA1 hash. A destructive containment action for confirmed malicious files.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

machine_id.description: Defender machine id to act on.
machine_id.title: Machine Id

comment.description: Reason/comment for this action, required by the Defender API and shown in the action audit trail.
comment.title: Comment

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List Alerts in the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant, optionally filtered by an OData $filter (e.g. "severity eq 'High'").

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_alert
tools.description: Read one Alert in full by its Defender alert id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_alert
tools.description: Update an Alert's status, classification, determination, and/or assignment.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

status.description: New status: 'New', 'InProgress', or 'Resolved'. Leave empty to not change.
status.title: Status

classification.description: 'TruePositive', 'FalsePositive', or 'Unknown'. Leave empty to not change.
classification.title: Classification

assigned_to.description: Email of the analyst to assign this alert to. Leave empty to not change.
assigned_to.title: Assigned To

comment.description: Optional comment to add to the alert.
comment.title: Comment

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: List custom Indicators (IOCs) configured on the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_indicator
tools.description: Create a custom Indicator (IOC) on the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant to flag or block a hash, IP, domain, or URL fleet-wide.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

indicator_value.description: The actual indicator value (hash, IP, domain, or URL).
indicator_value.title: Indicator Value

title.description: Short title for this indicator, shown in the console.
title.title: Title

description.description: Longer description of why this indicator was added.
description.title: Description

tools.name: delete_indicator
tools.description: Delete a custom Indicator (IOC) from the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: run_hunting_query
tools.description: Run an Advanced Hunting KQL query against the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant (e.g. "DeviceProcessEvents | take 10"). Read-only investigation.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Advanced Hunting KQL query, e.g. "DeviceProcessEvents | take 10".
query.title: Query

tools.name: list_vulnerabilities
tools.description: List CVEs (Threat & Vulnerability Management) exposed across the fleet or on one machine.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

machine_id.description: Optional: restrict to CVEs exposed on this one machine id.
machine_id.title: Machine Id

tools.name: audit_estate
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected Defender for Endpoint tenant: machine counts by health/isolation state, open/high-severity alerts, and critical CVE exposure.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Defender for Endpoint tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: defender_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Defender for Endpoint tenants and encrypted credentials. Managed only through connect_defender and disconnect_defender.
